objective: Recover genuine N GEX from unchanged all-gene integer metacell counts for Liu2020, preserving frozen native state membership and existing RBP normalization.

state_selection.scope: all frozen selected state MCs meeting purity; expression qualification follows existing RBP workflow, not gene-specific APA contributor sets

normalization.CPM: each gene integer MC count / same MC all-gene GEX integer total * 1e6
normalization.mean_log2CPM1: unweighted mean over qualified selected MCs of log2(CPM+1)
normalization.pooled_CPM: sum gene counts / sum all-gene GEX totals * 1e6
normalization.state_summary: equal library weights; additional equal-time sensitivity where multiple times

outputs: full all-gene library-state summaries, target-factor mapping and summaries, genuine human N/P contrast GEX covariates including original 2575 common hN-P APA genes
inferential_scope: descriptive fixed-library/condition comparison; heterogeneous N6/N8 conditions are not exchangeable biological replicates; no activity or causality inference
source_integrity: read-only remote access; hash before and after transfer; matrix row identity and n_cells must match original frozen GEX registry; integer counts and all-gene denominators conserved; symbols repaired only against pinned GRCh38-2024-A GTF
